card.name: Year digits in North Korea history
card.fires_on: The first digit of a year (mostly 1 in 19xx) inside an essay on North Korea's economic history. It also fires on the space or word just before a year.

modes.label: Year start
modes.description: The digit 1 or 5 that begins a year or year range in a passage about North Korea's decades.
modes.example: Then, during the mid-<<1>>970s, the country started

modes.label: Just before a year
modes.description: A space or short word right before a year is expected, in the same topic.
modes.example: Kim Il-sung, until his death in<< >>19

card.writes: It pushes toward Korean and Chinese place names and volume-like tokens, and away from European name fragments, which is not a clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on the first digit of years when a text is describing North Korea's history across the decades.
